title: Constant scalar restriction identifies the ambient ringed exchange
statement: For a commutative Cartesian square of schemes and any commutative constant coefficient ring A, restriction to constant scalar sections carries the specified ambient ringed exchange at every ordinary unbounded derived module complex K to an arrow isomorphic to the fixed-A-module-sheaf derived base-change map at the restriction of K. The coefficient comparisons are the fixed constant-section comparisons, with their induced composite compatibility. No properness, boundedness, classicality or torsion hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Module and pro-etale comparison paragraphs; Stacks 07A7, 093I, 03CY, 0D6D

proof.text: The exact scalar-restriction equivalences identify module direct images sectionwise: both evaluate on the same base-changed object, and the adjoint constant-section coefficient equation identifies their scalar actions. Conjugate these isomorphisms by the normalized pullback/direct-image adjunctions to obtain the inverse-image comparisons. Sectionwise composition of direct images and uniqueness of their conjugates identifies the ordinary pullback square.

Pass to complexes and derived categories. Exact equivalences preserve K-injectives, so the direct-image comparisons derive to isomorphisms; pullbacks derive termwise. The normalized termwise and K-flat characterization of the ambient composition comparison identifies its square with the encoded square. This uses the original ambient selector, rather than silently replacing it by the separately chosen compositor.

Expand both exchanges into unit, pullback square and counit. The derived adjunction unit/counit equations and the pullback cube give the three commuting squares of the three-step adjunction comparison. Their composite is the required arrow isomorphism. This is coefficient-encoding functoriality of exchange, independent of the proper-base-change assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleConstantExchange_encoding (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    (hc : HEq
      (proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients g' f
        (proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (proEtaleConstantRing X A) (proEtaleConstantRing X' A)
        (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f A) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison g' A))
      (proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients f' g
        (proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (proEtaleConstantRing Y' A) (proEtaleConstantRing X' A)
        (proEtaleConstantRingComparison g A) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f' A)))
    (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((proEtaleDerivedModuleRestriction Y' A).map
      ((proEtaleAmbientRingedExchange sq
        (proEtaleConstantRing X A) (proEtaleConstantRing Y A)
        (proEtaleConstantRing X' A) (proEtaleConstantRing Y' A)
        (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f A) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison g A)
        (proEtaleConstantRingComparison g' A) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f' A) hc).app K)) ≅
      Arrow.mk ((ProEtale.derivedBaseChangeMap
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) sq.toCommSq).app
          ((proEtaleDerivedModuleRestriction X A).obj K)))
